title: Tricks and Treats
description:
This is a mod meant for halloween time, adding a lot of cool features for all Minecrafters! 
Loot villages for candy, or wait for nighttime, and see cool zombies with pumpkin heads, and spiders laying webs!
body:
This is a mod meant for halloween time, adding a lot of cool features for all Minecrafters! 
Loot villages for candy, or wait for nighttime, and see cool zombies with pumpkin heads.

Raid an ancient city to find cotton candy and the grim reaper's scythe...

In pale gardens, you can find the White Pumpkin orinanting from Minecraft Storymode

And many more features!
